description: Accounting for Income Inequality in Geospatial Electricity Demand Projections under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways Namibian case study results is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mai ElSayed, Antti Pinomaa (Lappeenranta-Lahti University of Technology). These files represent the output of the Geospatial Residential Electricity Demand under Socioeconomic Inequality (GRED-SI) framework for a case study on Namibia. The output is in the format of GeoPackage files for each Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP), ranging from 1 to 5. Coverage: national (NA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
